description: Token counter, count LLM tokens (GPT, OpenAI tokenizer), context window check. Count tokens in a text with an offline tokenizer: OpenAI's o200k_base (the encoding of GPT-4o, GPT-4.1 and o-series models). Counts for other model families (Claude, Gemini, Llama) are estimates. Optionally checks whether it fits a limit. The text is not stored or logged. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: token_count
